title: Hidden insights that only a local can reveal.
text: My wife and I were lucky enough to have our own private tour which the company gracefuly honoured. Our guide, Zarapico, was brilliant: informative, helpful and entertaining. His  knowledge of the town was detailed, but it was the clear love he has for Carmona and surrounding area that made this trip special and anything but corporate. We would never have seen the view from the Paramor hotel terrace without  him, or the mosaic in the town hall. Thank you Zarapico, and Naturanda, for an unforgettable experience.

title: Enjoyable and informative trip to Carmona and the Necropolis
text:
Our guide Ivan provided an excellent and informative trip this morning. There were 7 of us in the bus and the commentary was both English and Spanish, we paced and excellent detail. We walked round Old Town Carmona, visited the oldest church and the Alcazar ( for the view as its now a hotel) and Ivan gave a great history background.

We then went to the Roman Necropolis for another fab piece of history.

Great half day out. Thank you Ivan
author: GrandTour63509296975

title: This half day tour was...
text: This half day tour was excellent. Our Guide Jose Luis was very engaging and full of interesting information. He took us all over the small town of Carmona and showed us corners not normally seen with other tours. We were a small group and he provided and unforgettable tour. He made sure that everyone understood his explanations. He took us up to the tower and provided so much interesting history about this quaint town. He even dropped us off closer to Plaza de Espana as a favor and we were very grateful. We took three tours with Naturanda tour company and would use them again.
author: Olga_G
